cong_thuc: SUM(B3:B7*C3:C7) + Ctrl+Shift+Enter: tinh tong tien = tong(soluong*dongia) tren ca mang, thay cho nhieu o phu.
=MAX(C2:C8-B2:B8) mang: tang truong cao nhat = max(doanhthu2020-doanhthu2019) theo tung cong ty.
=MIN(C2:C8-B2:B8) mang: tang truong thap nhat, nhan CSE de ra mang hieu.
=SUM(ISERROR(B3:B9)*1) mang + CSE: dem o loi (video hien B3:B9: 67,23,#N/A,#NAME?,blank,"",#DIV/0!); ISERROR tra TRUE/FALSE, *1 chuyen ve 1/0 roi SUM.
=SUM(--ISERROR(B3:B9)): hai dau tru -- tuong duong *1, chuyen TRUE/FALSE ve so (video hien B3:B9).
=SUM(ISBLANK(B3:B9)*1) mang: dem o trong; ISBLANK=TRUE chi voi o that su rong, chuoi "" khong tinh.
=SUM((NOT(ISBLANK(B3:B9)))*1) hay SUM((ISBLANK(...)=FALSE)*1): dem o khong trong.
=MAX(IF((A3:A11="Cao")*(B3:B11="Thap"),C3:C11)) mang: diem lon nhat voi 2 dieu kien (dau * la AND).
=MIN(IF((dk1)*(dk2),vung_diem)): diem nho nhat theo nhieu dieu kien.
=COUNT(MATCH(G2:G5,vung,0)): dem so o thuoc tap {1,2,5,7}; MATCH tim thay tra vi tri (>0), COUNT dem so.
=SUM(MID(B3,ROW(INDIRECT("1:"&LEN(B3))),1)*1) mang: tong cac chu so; ROW+INDIRECT tao day 1..n, MID tach tung ky tu.
=SUM(ROW(INDIRECT(A2&":"&B2))) hoac SUM(INDEX...): tong day so tu so-bat-dau den so-ket-thuc, vi du 2..100 = 5049.
=AVERAGE(ROW(INDIRECT(A2&":"&B2))): trung binh day so, vi du 1..100 = 50.5.
Nhan Ctrl+Shift+Enter (CSE): ket thuc cong thuc mang; Excel tu them { } hai dau, khong tu go ngoac nhon.
=SUMPRODUCT(B2:B6*C2:C6)/SUM(B2:B6)=24.05% (frame 15:20): cach thay CSE khi tinh % hoan thanh du an; frame hien chu 'Ham SUMPRODUCT' 24.05%, khoi nhan Ctrl+Shift+Enter.
=COUNT(MATCH(A1:D11,G2:G5,0)) + CSE =16 (frame 23:40): dem so o thuoc tap {1,2,5,7} tren vung A1:D11; MATCH(...,0) tim chinh xac, COUNT dem so tim thay.
{=SUM(MID(B3,ROW(INDIRECT("1:"&LEN(B3))),1)*1)} =16 voi B3=565 (frame 28:40 + Evaluate Formula): LEN lay 3, ROW+INDIRECT tao {1;2;3}, MID tach 5,6,5 roi *1 ep so.
Loc unique bang COUNTIF+MATCH+INDEX (vi du 9, 30:00): dem so lan xuat hien truoc do, MATCH tim vi tri dau, INDEX lay ten duy nhat; phuc tap, can Evaluate tung buoc.
Vi tri hoc vien diem cao nhat (vi du 10, 33:20): cong thuc mang nang cao ket hop MAX+IF+MATCH theo dieu kien, video goi y tu hoc them.
thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: mo file Bai 21, bat Enable Editing; xac dinh vung mang (so luong, don gia, vung loi/rong, dieu kien).
Buoc 2: go cong thuc tham chieu ca vung thay vi tung o (vi du =SUM(B3:B7*C3:C7)).
Buoc 3: nhan giu Ctrl+Shift roi Enter (thay vi Enter) de kich hoat mang; kiem tra dau { } xuat hien.
Buoc 4: dung Formulas > Evaluate Formula de chay tung buoc, xem mang nhan/tru va tong hop ket qua.
Buoc 5: voi TRUE/FALSE (ISERROR/ISBLANK/IF) nhan *1 hoac them -- de ep ve 1/0 truoc khi SUM.
Buoc 6: voi nhieu dieu kien dung (dk1)*(dk2) trong IF (nhan = AND logic) roi boc MAX/MIN ngoai cung.
Buoc 7: thay doi du lieu goc (vi du sua doanh thu) va quan sat ket qua mang tu cap nhat; doi chieu voi cach tinh thu cong.
Buoc 8: bai tap ve nha: tim doanh thu NHO NHAT nhung >0 bang =MIN(IF(vung>0,vung)) + CSE, bo qua o bang 0.

cau_hoi.cau: Cong thuc mang (array formula) khac cong thuc thuong o diem nao?
cau_hoi.A: Xu ly nhieu gia tri (mang) trong 1 cong thuc
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Mang tham chieu ca vung va tra ket qua tong hop trong mot o.

cau_hoi.cau: De ket thuc mot cong thuc mang phai nhan to hop nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu Ctrl+Shift roi Enter, Excel tu them ngoac nhon.

cau_hoi.cau: Dau hieu nhan biet mot o dang chua cong thuc mang la gi?
cau_hoi.A: O co mau nen xanh
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Excel tu dong them { } quanh cong thuc mang.

cau_hoi.cau: =SUM(B3:B7*C3:C7) dung de lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Cong tien tung dong roi SUM
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Nhan 2 mang so-luong va don-gia roi tong mot lan
cau_hoi.giai_thich: B3:B7 nhan tuong ung C3:C7 roi SUM, khoi can cot phu.

cau_hoi.cau: Vi sao phai nhan Ctrl+Shift+Enter cho cong thuc tren?
cau_hoi.A: De Excel tinh theo che do mang
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khong CSE thi phep nhan mang khong tong hop dung.

cau_hoi.cau: Ham nao dem so o loi trong vung B3:B9? (video hien B3:B9)
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: ISERROR tra TRUE/FALSE, *1 ep ve so roi SUM.

cau_hoi.cau: Tac dung cua *1 (hoac --) sau ISERROR/ISBLANK la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Trang tri
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: SUM chi cong duoc so nen phai ep kieu.

cau_hoi.cau: =SUM(--ISERROR(D3:D9)) cho ket qua nao neu co 3 o loi?
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 3 gia tri TRUE thanh 3 so 1, tong bang 3.

cau_hoi.cau: Ham nao kiem tra mot o co phai o trong that su?
cau_hoi.A: ISBLANK
cau_hoi.giai_thich: ISBLANK=TRUE chi khi o rong that, chuoi "" van la FALSE.

cau_hoi.cau: O chua ="" (chuoi rong) thi ISBLANK tra ve gi?
cau_hoi.A: TRUE
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Vi o chua cong thuc nen khong phai o trong.

cau_hoi.cau: Cong thuc dem o KHONG trong la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: NOT dao nguoc roi ep so va SUM theo mang.

cau_hoi.cau: =MAX(C2:C8-B2:B8) + CSE tinh gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Lay mang 2020 tru mang 2019 roi lay max.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon tinh tang truong thap nhat dung ham nao boc ngoai?
cau_hoi.A: MIN
cau_hoi.giai_thich: MIN cua mang hieu = muc tang thap nhat.

cau_hoi.cau: Sua mot gia tri doanh thu goc thi ket qua MAX/MIN mang se?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Cong thuc tham chieu dong nen tu tinh lai.

cau_hoi.cau: De tinh diem lon nhat khi Rui ro=Cao VA Doanh thu=Thap dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dau * noi 2 dieu kien kieu AND trong IF.

cau_hoi.cau: Trong cong thuc tren, dau * giua 2 bieu thuc logic co y nghia?
cau_hoi.A: Nhan so hoc
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: TRUE*TRUE=1, chi dong thoa ca 2 moi duoc lay.

cau_hoi.cau: Tinh diem NHO NHAT voi 2 dieu kien thi doi ham ngoai thanh gi?
cau_hoi.A: MIN
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu nguyen IF dieu kien, doi MAX thanh MIN.

cau_hoi.cau: =COUNT(MATCH(A1:D11,G2:G5,0)) dem cai gi? (ket qua 16)
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: MATCH tim thay tra vi tri, COUNT dem so lan thay.

cau_hoi.cau: Tham so 0 trong MATCH(...,0) nghia la?
cau_hoi.A: Tim tuong doi
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 0 = exact match, bat buoc khi dem theo tap gia tri.

cau_hoi.cau: LEN(B3) trong bai tong chu so dung de?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Dem so ky tu de tao day 1..n
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Do dai chuoi quyet dinh so lan tach MID.

cau_hoi.cau: ROW(INDIRECT("1:"&LEN(B3))) tao ra gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Day so thu tu lam start_num cho MID.

cau_hoi.cau: MID(so,k,1) trong bai co tac dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tach tung chu so ra khoi con so.

cau_hoi.cau: Vi sao cuoi MID phai *1?
cau_hoi.A: De trang tri
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Ep ky tu so dang text ve so that
cau_hoi.giai_thich: MID tra text, *1 ep ve so moi SUM duoc.

cau_hoi.cau: So 565 cho tong chu so bang bao nhieu?
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 5+6+5=16, cong thuc mang tra 16.

cau_hoi.cau: =SUM(ROW(INDIRECT(A2&":"&B2))) voi A2=2,B2=100 cho?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tong cac so nguyen tu 2 den 100.

cau_hoi.cau: =AVERAGE(ROW(INDIRECT(1&":"&100))) cho?
INDEX(A2&":"&B2) trong meo ROW+INDEX dung de?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Tao tham chieu dang text thanh vung that
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Noi dia chi kieu "2:5" roi bien thanh vung.

cau_hoi.cau: Cong cu nao giup xem tung buoc chay cua cong thuc mang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Evaluate chay tung phep nhan/tru/tong de hieu.

cau_hoi.cau: Co duoc tu go { } quanh cong thuc mang khong?
cau_hoi.A: Khong, Excel tu them khi CSE
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tu go ngoac nhon se thanh text, phai CSE.

cau_hoi.cau: Sua/Xoa 1 o trong vung mang nhieu o se?
cau_hoi.A: Tu do
cau_hoi.B: Excel bao loi, phai xu ly ca vung
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Mang nhieu o rang buoc chung, khong sua le.

cau_hoi.cau: SUMPRODUCT co the thay CSE trong truong hop nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: SUMPRODUCT xu ly mang san, thuong khong can CSE.

cau_hoi.cau: Ket qua =SUM(B3:B7*C3:C7) trong bai hoc bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dung nhu cach tinh thu cong tong tien.

cau_hoi.cau: Bai tap ve nha cuoi video yeu cau gi?
cau_hoi.A: Tim doanh thu nho nhat nhung >0
cau_hoi.giai_thich: =MIN(IF(vung>0,vung)) + CSE, bo qua o 0.

cau_hoi.cau: Vi sao phai loai o 0 khi tim min?
cau_hoi.A: 0 lam dep
cau_hoi.B: Nhieu thang nghi khong co doanh thu (=0) se keo min ve 0
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chi xet o >0 moi ra min co y nghia.

cau_hoi.cau: =MIN(IF(vung>0,vung)) phai ket thuc bang?
cau_hoi.A: Enter thuong
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: IF tra mang nen phai CSE.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon dem so o chua 1 trong 4 gia tri {1,2,5,7} dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: MATCH tung gia tri trong tap roi COUNT.

cau_hoi.cau: De tach loc danh sach duy nhat (unique) video goi y ham nao?
cau_hoi.A: Ket hop COUNTIF + MATCH + INDEX (mang)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dem so lan xuat hien truoc do de lay lan dau.

cau_hoi.cau: Loi #DIV/0! trong vi du duoc tao bang cach nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chia cho 0 de minh hoa ISERROR bat loi.

cau_hoi.cau: Loi ich lon nhat cua cong thuc mang theo bai?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Gon, khoi cot phu, tu cap nhat
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Mot cong thuc thay nhieu buoc trung gian.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon tinh tong tien truc tiep khong can cot phu trung gian dung cach nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Mang nhan 2 vung va tong mot lan, gon nhat.
